name: graph-motor-studio
description: graph-motor studio — a graphical interface for the whole engine: provisional ingest in, wasm layout out, aurora-glass Canvas2D view. Imports the published SDK from crates/graph-sdk-js and the render layer from src/core; owns no engine code.
//versions: Pinned EXACT, never caret-ranged. react/react-dom are 19.2.5, the versions the root package.json pins, so the studio and the engine's own React adapter run on one runtime. vite is the latest stable at authoring time; a range here would silently pull a major the esbuild JSX path has not been checked against. typescript is pinned to the 5.x line (not the 7.x latest) because `tsc --noEmit -p .` is a gate row here and a compiler swap is not a UI change.
